description: This file defines a Perl ResultSet class for 'User' entities within the Coocook schema, including methods for validation, querying, and filtering user data.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::User
classes.description: A ResultSet class for performing database operations related to User entities, including validation and filtering methods.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the default sorting column for user results, which is 'name_fc'.

methods.name: email_valid_and_available
methods.description: Checks if an email is valid, not blacklisted, and not already associated with an existing user or pending email change.

methods.name: name_available
methods.description: Checks if a username is available by verifying it against blacklists and existing organizations.

methods.name: site_owners
methods.description: Retrieves users with the role of 'site_owner'.

methods.name: with_projects_count
methods.description: Retrieves users along with a count of their associated projects.

methods.name: with_valid_limited_token
methods.description: Filters users who have a valid, limited token that has not expired.

methods.name: with_valid_or_unlimited_token
methods.description: Filters users who have either an unexpired token or no token expiration set.
